propositions: The host updater script uses pipx with a Git URL that bypasses the committed uv.lock and Click security override, enabling unlocked dependency resolution.
The updater must instead check out an exact SHA from git ls-remote and run uv sync --locked with no-dev flag and runtime/operator extras to preserve locked dependencies and the Click override.
Failed sync or smoke-test stages must reject the candidate, log the failure reason, and preserve the current release unchanged.
After successful build and test, the updater must atomically publish only the versioned release and remove rejected candidates, maintaining single-flight safety.
Published runtime must report Click 8.4.2 and pass pip-audit with no PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability.
An immediate subsequent launchd run must detect no change and exit cleanly without re-publishing.
